consumer: The engine's own dialogue/condition predicate via conditional_t::set_has_item (u_has_item), which computes the yes/no 'does the actor have item c4?' that a condition/mission/dialogue eligibility check consumes.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory), as charges_of(c4)>0 || has_amount(c4,1) over the player actor
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item -- its body returns actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1) over the alpha/beta player actor, the engine-computed possession verdict.
divergence: The avatar carries a c4 nested inside a gun or magazine: visit_internal and the flat carried_items[] export do not descend into gun/magazine contents, so re-deriving 'has c4' from the snapshot returns false while the engine predicate's charges_of/has_amount returns true -- exposing the display-derived answer as wrong.
